# Struct Tags & JSON in Go

Struct tags are metadata strings attached to struct fields. Most commonly used with the `encoding/json` package to control JSON serialization and deserialization.

## Struct Tag Syntax

Struct tags are written as raw string literals (backticks) after the field type:

```go
type User struct {
    ID       int    `json:"id"`
    Username string `json:"username"`
    Password string `json:"-"`            // skip this field
    Age      int    `json:"age,omitempty"` // skip if zero
}
```

## json.Marshal — Struct to JSON

```go
p := Product{ID: 1, Name: "Laptop", Price: 15000000}
data, err := json.Marshal(p)
fmt.Println(string(data))
// {"id":1,"name":"Laptop","price":15000000}

pretty, _ := json.MarshalIndent(p, "", "  ")
fmt.Println(string(pretty))
```

## json.Unmarshal — JSON to Struct

```go
jsonData := `{"id":2,"name":"Mouse","price":250000}`
var product Product
err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonData), &product)
fmt.Println(product.Name)  // Mouse
```

## omitempty and json:"-"

```go
type Response struct {
    Code    int    `json:"code"`
    Message string `json:"message"`
    Error   string `json:"error,omitempty"` // skipped if empty
}
// {"code":200,"message":"OK"} — no error field
```

## API Response Pattern

```go
type APIResponse struct {
    Success bool        `json:"success"`
    Code    int         `json:"code"`
    Data    interface{} `json:"data,omitempty"`
    Error   *APIError   `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
```

quiz.question_id: Apa fungsi utama struct tag `json:"id"` pada field?
quiz.question_en: What is the main purpose of a struct tag like `json:"id"` on a field?
options_id: Mengatur nama field saat serialisasi/deserialisasi JSON
options_en: It makes the field private
It controls the field name during JSON serialization/deserialization
It changes the field type to string
It marks the field as required to be non-zero

quiz.question_id: Apa arti tag `json:"-"` pada field struct?
quiz.question_en: What does the tag `json:"-"` mean on a struct field?
options_en: The field will be named `-` in JSON
The field is excluded from JSON processing
The field must be populated before marshaling
The field is only used during unmarshal

quiz.question_id: Apa efek `omitempty` pada field string bernilai `""` saat marshal?
quiz.question_en: What is the effect of `omitempty` on a string field whose value is `""` during marshaling?
options_id: Field tetap muncul dengan nilai kosong
options_en: The field still appears with an empty value
The field is omitted from the JSON output
Marshaling fails with an error
The field becomes `null`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa field `Password string `json:"-"`` pada lesson adalah desain yang masuk akal?
quiz.question_en: Why is a field like `Password string `json:"-"`` a sensible design in the lesson?
options_id: Agar password tidak ikut terekspos ke JSON output atau diproses sebagai data API biasa
Agar `encoding/json` menghapus field dari struct di memori
options_en: So the password is not exposed in JSON output or treated as normal API data
So the password is automatically encrypted
So `encoding/json` removes the field from the in-memory struct
So the password field becomes exported

quiz.question_id: Fungsi mana yang menghasilkan `[]byte` dari sebuah struct?
quiz.question_en: Which function produces `[]byte` from a struct?
options_en: `json.Unmarshal`
`json.Marshal`
`json.Decode`
`json.Parse`

options_id: Saat butuh output JSON yang lebih mudah dibaca manusia
Saat JSON harus selalu tanpa spasi
Saat field private ingin ikut dimarshal
options_en: When you want JSON output that is easier for humans to read
When you need to unmarshal into a struct
When the JSON must always contain no spaces
When you want private fields to be marshaled too

quiz.question_id: Mengapa argumen kedua `json.Unmarshal` harus berupa pointer seperti `&product`?
quiz.question_en: Why must the second argument to `json.Unmarshal` be a pointer such as `&product`?
options_id: Karena `Unmarshal` perlu memodifikasi nilai tujuan dengan data hasil decode
Karena `Unmarshal` hanya menerima pointer demi performa
Karena struct biasa tidak punya alamat memori
Karena tanpa pointer JSON akan otomatis jadi map
options_en: Because `Unmarshal` needs to modify the destination value with the decoded data
Because `Unmarshal` only accepts pointers for performance reasons
Because ordinary structs do not have memory addresses
Because without a pointer the JSON would automatically become a map

quiz.question_id: Jika JSON nested berisi objek `address`, bagaimana field itu dipetakan pada struct `User` di starter code?
quiz.question_en: If nested JSON contains an `address` object, how is that mapped onto the `User` struct in the starter code?
options_id: Ke field `Address` yang juga struct dengan tag JSON pada field-fieldnya
Harus selalu di-unmarshal manual setelah field lain selesai
Tidak bisa; `encoding/json` hanya mendukung field primitif
options_en: Into the `Address` field, which is itself a struct with JSON tags on its fields
It must always be unmarshaled manually after the other fields
It cannot; `encoding/json` only supports primitive fields
It automatically becomes a raw JSON string

quiz.question_id: Apa tradeoff umum dari penggunaan `interface{}` atau `any` pada field `Data` respons API?
quiz.question_en: What is a common tradeoff of using `interface{}` or `any` for an API response `Data` field?
options_id: Lebih fleksibel untuk berbagai bentuk payload, tetapi kurang type-safe dibanding field konkret
options_en: It is more flexible for varying payload shapes, but less type-safe than a concrete field
It is more type-safe than a concrete type
It makes `omitempty` stop working
It prevents nested structs from being marshaled

quiz.question_id: Pernyataan mana yang paling akurat tentang struct tags dan `encoding/json`?
quiz.question_en: Which statement is most accurate about struct tags and `encoding/json`?
options_id: Struct tags memungkinkan kontrol nama field, penghilangan field tertentu, dan perilaku seperti `omitempty` saat proses JSON
Struct tags hanya dipakai saat unmarshaling, bukan marshaling
Struct tags mengubah definisi tipe field di compile time
Struct tags wajib pada setiap field struct di Go
options_en: Struct tags let you control field names, omit certain fields, and use behaviors like `omitempty` during JSON processing
Struct tags are only used during unmarshaling, not marshaling
Struct tags change the field's type definition at compile time
Struct tags are required on every struct field in Go
